proof_boundary: These cases exercise deterministic offline advice only. They do not open Grok Bot, authenticate, send messages, or prove live UI delivery.

cases.user_prompt: Prepare this reviewed handoff in my authorized Grok Bot conversation and avoid duplicate sends.
cases.expected_workflow: Confirm the recorded operator and target, hash the exact message, observe that it is absent, and advise one paste before any send.

cases.user_prompt: The send action timed out. Check whether the exact handoff is already visible before doing anything else.
cases.expected_workflow: Use the message digest and a fresh matching-sent observation to mark the send as visible without retrying it.

cases.user_prompt: Grok posted progress five minutes ago. Decide whether a follow-up is due under the 20-minute policy.
cases.expected_workflow: Anchor the delay to the latest progress, keep waiting, and return the next deterministic check time.

cases.user_prompt: There has been no progress for 30 minutes. Check whether one bounded nudge is due.
cases.expected_workflow: Apply the configured first-delay and cap, then advise a nudge because the due time has passed and no nudge was recorded.

cases.user_prompt: The coordination task is complete. Decide whether the same message should be sent again.
cases.expected_workflow: Recognize the terminal phase and stop the send path.

cases.user_prompt: Send the draft even though another operator owns this conversation record.
cases.expected_workflow: Refuse this sender and stop because the recorded single-writer owner differs.
cases.negative_why: A second writer could duplicate or conflict with the recorded operator's send.

cases.user_prompt: Send this new message while a different prior message still has an uncertain send result.
cases.expected_workflow: Require reconciliation of the earlier uncertain digest instead of authorizing a new send.
cases.negative_why: Sending before reconciling the earlier outcome could duplicate or reorder messages.

cases.user_prompt: Resend the same handoff even though the Bot already acknowledged it.
cases.expected_workflow: Stop because acknowledgement for the same digest is evidence that the message was already sent.
cases.negative_why: The requested resend would create a duplicate in the external conversation.

cases.user_prompt: Send the handoff without a recorded target conversation.
cases.expected_workflow: Require target inspection and avoid paste or send advice until the target is set.
cases.negative_why: Without an exact target, the plugin cannot establish where the external message would go.
